artful.oewn-00149002-a.label: negative
artful.oewn-00149002-a.tone: Skill first, deceit second - it can admire the craft even while it disapproves.

crafty.oewn-00149346-s.label: negative
crafty.oewn-00149346-s.tone: Homely and old, and the craft is entirely in the deceiving.

cunning.oewn-00149346-s.label: negative
cunning.oewn-00149346-s.tone: Half-admiring when said of animals and plans, condemning when said of people.

dodgy.oewn-00149346-s.label: negative
dodgy.oewn-00149346-s.tone: British and everyday; *a bit dodgy* covers everything from a stranger to a knee.

foxy.oewn-00149346-s.label: negative
foxy.oewn-00149346-s.tone: The animal metaphor, and easily confused with the unrelated sense meaning attractive.

guileful.oewn-00149346-s.label: negative
guileful.oewn-00149346-s.tone: Formal and rare - the deceiving is deliberate and rather cold.

knavish.oewn-00149346-s.label: negative
knavish.oewn-00149346-s.tone: Names the person a knave; the word has aged into costume drama.

slick.oewn-00149346-s.label: negative
slick.oewn-00149346-s.tone: The deception is in the smoothness - nothing catches, which is what makes it suspect.

sly.oewn-00149346-s.label: negative
sly.oewn-00149346-s.tone: The everyday word, and the one that emphasises secrecy over skill.

tricksy.oewn-00149346-s.label: negative
tricksy.oewn-00149346-s.tone: Playful rather than dangerous: mischief with a literary air.

tricky.oewn-00149346-s.label: negative
tricky.oewn-00149346-s.tone: Has drifted to describing problems rather than people; of a person it is still a warning.

wily.oewn-00149346-s.label: negative
wily.oewn-00149346-s.tone: Cunning with the disapproval taken out - a wily negotiator is being complimented.

cute.oewn-00149910-s.label: negative
cute.oewn-00149910-s.tone: *Don't get cute with me* - charm deployed as a manoeuvre.

precious.oewn-00149910-s.label: negative
precious.oewn-00149910-s.tone: Affectation as a whole manner - too studied to be trusted.

designing.oewn-00150120-s.label: negative
designing.oewn-00150120-s.tone: The intent is sustained and concealed, which is worse than a single trick.

scheming.oewn-00150120-s.label: negative
scheming.oewn-00150120-s.tone: The furthest word here: plotting as an ongoing occupation.

merciless.oewn-01511081-a.label: negative
merciless.oewn-01511081-a.tone: Mercy was available and was withheld; that is the entire charge.

unmerciful.oewn-01511081-a.label: negative
unmerciful.oewn-01511081-a.tone: The same judgement in the older negative form, and slightly more formal.

cutthroat.oewn-01511487-s.label: negative
cutthroat.oewn-01511487-s.tone: Lives in business now, where it is half a boast about the market.

fierce.oewn-01511487-s.label: negative
fierce.oewn-01511487-s.tone: Often admiring - fierce loyalty and fierce defence are praise.

bowelless.oewn-01511487-s.label: negative
bowelless.oewn-01511487-s.tone: The bowels were once the seat of pity; without that, the word is opaque.

mortal.oewn-01511671-s.label: negative
mortal.oewn-01511671-s.tone: *A mortal enemy* - deadly rather than pitiless, and archaic in flavour.

pitiless.oewn-01511765-s.label: negative
pitiless.oewn-01511765-s.tone: Said as easily of weather and landscape as of people, and just as final.

remorseless.oewn-01511765-s.label: negative
remorseless.oewn-01511765-s.tone: Adds the aftermath: there was no regret once it was done.

ruthless.oewn-01511765-s.label: negative
ruthless.oewn-01511765-s.tone: The everyday word, and the one business writing quietly turns into a compliment.

unpitying.oewn-01511765-s.label: negative
unpitying.oewn-01511765-s.tone: The plainer, rarer form of *pitiless*, and a shade cooler.

tigerish.oewn-01511999-s.label: negative
tigerish.oewn-01511999-s.tone: Fierceness by animal comparison, which softens it into a figure of speech.

contented.oewn-00591490-a.label: positive
contented.oewn-00591490-a.tone: Settled rather than delighted; it describes a steady state, not a mood.

content.oewn-00591490-a.label: positive
content.oewn-00591490-a.tone: The plainest form, and often used of accepting less than one wanted.

complacent.oewn-00591760-s.label: negative
complacent.oewn-00591760-s.tone: Contentment that should have been alarm - the danger was there to be seen.

self-satisfied.oewn-00591760-s.label: negative
self-satisfied.oewn-00591760-s.tone: The satisfaction is with oneself, and it is visible to everyone else.

self-complacent.oewn-00591760-s.label: negative
self-complacent.oewn-00591760-s.tone: The formal doubling of the same fault, and stiffer for it.

satisfied.oewn-00592037-s.label: positive
satisfied.oewn-00592037-s.tone: Closest to neutral here - a condition met rather than a character described.

smug.oewn-00592141-s.label: negative
smug.oewn-00592141-s.tone: The social version: pleasure in being right, worn where others can see it.

unrefined.oewn-01955971-a.label: negative
unrefined.oewn-01955971-a.tone: Descriptive and mild - it names an absence rather than an offence.

agrestic.oewn-01956433-s.label: negative
agrestic.oewn-01956433-s.tone: Rural coarseness, bookish enough to sound like a judgement from a distance.

artless.oewn-01956562-s.label: negative
artless.oewn-01956562-s.tone: In this sense it means untrained. In its commoner sense it is praise for being without guile.

uncultivated.oewn-01956562-s.label: negative
uncultivated.oewn-01956562-s.tone: The farming metaphor is intact: nothing was planted here.

uncultured.oewn-01956562-s.label: negative
uncultured.oewn-01956562-s.tone: Sharper, because culture is treated as something the person declined to acquire.

boorish.oewn-01956681-s.label: negative
boorish.oewn-01956681-s.tone: Ill-manners as a settled character, and contemptible with it.

loutish.oewn-01956681-s.label: negative
loutish.oewn-01956681-s.tone: Young, male and physical - the lout takes up space and does not apologise.

neanderthal.oewn-01956681-s.label: negative
neanderthal.oewn-01956681-s.tone: Denies the person their own century; the insult is evolutionary.

oafish.oewn-01956681-s.label: negative
oafish.oewn-01956681-s.tone: Clumsiness and stupidity together, with no suggestion it could be helped.

swinish.oewn-01956681-s.label: negative
swinish.oewn-01956681-s.tone: The animal comparison again, here about manners rather than appetite.

coarse.oewn-01957020-s.label: negative
coarse.oewn-01957020-s.tone: About texture originally, and it still suggests something unfinished.

common.oewn-01957020-s.label: negative
common.oewn-01957020-s.tone: Pure class contempt - the word says more about the speaker than the subject.

rough-cut.oewn-01957020-s.label: negative
rough-cut.oewn-01957020-s.tone: Nearly forgiving: the material is good, the finishing was never done.

uncouth.oewn-01957020-s.label: negative
uncouth.oewn-01957020-s.tone: Once simply *unknown*; the strangeness curdled into rudeness.

vulgar.oewn-01957020-s.label: negative
vulgar.oewn-01957020-s.tone: Coarseness with class in it - the offence is against taste as much as manners.

naive.oewn-02279294-a.label: negative
naive.oewn-02279294-a.tone: The everyday word, and gentler than it looks - it blames inexperience, not intellect.

naif.oewn-02279294-a.label: negative
naif.oewn-02279294-a.tone: The French spelling, used when the writer wants a touch of distance.

childlike.oewn-02279797-s.label: positive
childlike.oewn-02279797-s.tone: Warm. It keeps the simplicity and drops the accusation.

wide-eyed.oewn-02279797-s.label: neutral
wide-eyed.oewn-02279797-s.tone: Describes the face rather than the judgement; it can be wonder or it can be folly.

round-eyed.oewn-02279797-s.label: neutral
round-eyed.oewn-02279797-s.tone: The same picture, rarer and slightly more comic.

dewy-eyed.oewn-02279797-s.label: negative
dewy-eyed.oewn-02279797-s.tone: Faintly mocking - the sentimentality is being pointed at.

simple.oewn-02279797-s.label: negative
simple.oewn-02279797-s.tone: Dangerous, because it slides into the old sense meaning intellectually limited.

credulous.oewn-02280055-s.label: negative
credulous.oewn-02280055-s.tone: Names the mechanism: this person believes things on insufficient evidence.

fleeceable.oewn-02280235-s.label: negative
fleeceable.oewn-02280235-s.tone: Defines the person by what can be done to them, which is why it stings.

green.oewn-02280235-s.label: negative
green.oewn-02280235-s.tone: Inexperience with an expiry date: a state to be grown out of, not a fault.

gullible.oewn-02280235-s.label: negative
gullible.oewn-02280235-s.tone: The plain accusation - it implies a history of being fooled.

innocent.oewn-02280420-s.label: positive
innocent.oewn-02280420-s.tone: Praise with a shadow: the same word can mean unspoiled or unprepared.

ingenuous.oewn-02280420-s.label: positive
ingenuous.oewn-02280420-s.tone: Frankness without calculation; the opposite of *disingenuous*, which is the commoner word.

simple-minded.oewn-02280704-s.label: negative
simple-minded.oewn-02280704-s.tone: The harshest here, and it borrows the vocabulary of disability to do its work.

unsophisticated.oewn-02280838-s.label: negative
unsophisticated.oewn-02280838-s.tone: Formal and faintly condescending - sophistication is assumed to be the goal.

unworldly.oewn-02280838-s.label: neutral
unworldly.oewn-02280838-s.tone: Can be reproach or admiration, depending entirely on what the world is thought to be worth.

wise.oewn-02579686-a.label: positive
wise.oewn-02579686-a.tone: The plain word, and the one that has to be earned rather than displayed.

all-knowing.oewn-02580010-s.label: positive
all-knowing.oewn-02580010-s.tone: Wisdom claimed without limit, which is why it turns sarcastic so easily.

omniscient.oewn-02580010-s.label: positive
omniscient.oewn-02580010-s.tone: The technical form, at home in theology and in narration.

perspicacious.oewn-02580114-s.label: positive
perspicacious.oewn-02580114-s.tone: Sharpness of perception; it praises the seeing rather than the knowing.

sagacious.oewn-02580114-s.label: positive
sagacious.oewn-02580114-s.tone: Formal and warm, and often used of judgement under pressure.

sapient.oewn-02580114-s.label: positive
sapient.oewn-02580114-s.tone: Latinate and cool - it is the species name doing double duty.

owlish.oewn-02580501-s.label: positive
owlish.oewn-02580501-s.tone: Appearance only. The owl looks wise; that is the whole of its claim.

sapiential.oewn-02580602-s.label: positive
sapiential.oewn-02580602-s.tone: Theological, and about wisdom as a body of teaching rather than a trait.

sage.oewn-02580739-s.label: positive
sage.oewn-02580739-s.tone: Wisdom that came with age, and the noun stands just behind the adjective.

domineering.oewn-00790691-a.label: negative
domineering.oewn-00790691-a.tone: A habit of overriding others, described from the outside.

authoritarian.oewn-00790912-s.label: negative
authoritarian.oewn-00790912-s.tone: Political, and it scales from a parent to a state without changing meaning.

dictatorial.oewn-00790912-s.label: negative
dictatorial.oewn-00790912-s.tone: Borrows a form of government to describe a manner; the comparison is the insult.

overbearing.oewn-00790912-s.label: negative
overbearing.oewn-00790912-s.tone: The weight metaphor is exact - the other person is pressed down, not persuaded.

autocratic.oewn-00791150-s.label: negative
autocratic.oewn-00791150-s.tone: Power exercised alone, and answerable to nobody.

bossy.oewn-00791150-s.label: negative
bossy.oewn-00791150-s.tone: The mildest here - it belittles the manner rather than condemning the power.

dominating.oewn-00791150-s.label: negative
dominating.oewn-00791150-s.tone: Neutral in sport and unpleasant in a room; the context carries the charge.

high-and-mighty.oewn-00791150-s.label: negative
high-and-mighty.oewn-00791150-s.tone: Mock-grand, and the mockery is doing the condemning.

magisterial.oewn-00791150-s.label: negative
magisterial.oewn-00791150-s.tone: Splits cleanly: a magisterial book is authoritative, a magisterial manner is unbearable.

peremptory.oewn-00791150-s.label: negative
peremptory.oewn-00791150-s.tone: It allows no reply, which is the whole of the offence.

blustery.oewn-00791587-s.label: negative
blustery.oewn-00791587-s.tone: Noise without much force behind it; more ridiculous than frightening.

bullying.oewn-00791587-s.label: negative
bullying.oewn-00791587-s.tone: The one word here that names harm rather than manner.

cavalier.oewn-00791700-s.label: negative
cavalier.oewn-00791700-s.tone: Disregard worn lightly, as though the other person's stake were not real.

high-handed.oewn-00791700-s.label: negative
high-handed.oewn-00791700-s.tone: About a single act more often than a character - a decision taken over someone's head.

heavy-handed.oewn-00791823-s.label: negative
heavy-handed.oewn-00791823-s.tone: Force without proportion - more was applied than the thing needed.

roughshod.oewn-00791823-s.label: negative
roughshod.oewn-00791823-s.tone: *Ride roughshod over* - disregard rather than violence; the shoes are the image.

elegant.oewn-00852781-a.label: positive
elegant.oewn-00852781-a.tone: Restraint doing the work - the highest praise in the family, and the quietest.

dandified.oewn-00853318-s.label: negative
dandified.oewn-00853318-s.tone: Elegance turned into a project, and visibly so.

dandyish.oewn-00853318-s.label: negative
dandyish.oewn-00853318-s.tone: The same fault named after the person rather than the process.

foppish.oewn-00853318-s.label: negative
foppish.oewn-00853318-s.tone: Beyond dandified: the appearance has crowded out everything else.

deluxe.oewn-00853459-s.label: positive
deluxe.oewn-00853459-s.tone: A marketing word before it was a compliment, and it still sounds like packaging.

de_luxe.oewn-00853459-s.label: positive
de_luxe.oewn-00853459-s.tone: The spaced spelling, older and slightly more formal.

luxe.oewn-00853459-s.label: positive
luxe.oewn-00853459-s.tone: Clipped and fashion-trade; it names a look rather than a quality.

fine.oewn-00853589-s.label: positive
fine.oewn-00853589-s.tone: Enormously overworked elsewhere, but in this sense it is genuine praise.

high-class.oewn-00853840-s.label: negative
high-class.oewn-00853840-s.tone: Pretension is built into the gloss - it announces a rank rather than showing one.

high-toned.oewn-00853840-s.label: negative
high-toned.oewn-00853840-s.tone: The same claim with more disapproval attached.

exquisite.oewn-00853958-s.label: positive
exquisite.oewn-00853958-s.tone: Praise at the limit, and it implies the observer noticed every detail.

recherche.oewn-00853958-s.label: positive
recherche.oewn-00853958-s.tone: Rare and studied. Whether that is praise depends on how hard the search shows.

ritzy.oewn-00854054-s.label: neutral
ritzy.oewn-00854054-s.tone: Luxury with a raised eyebrow: elegance that announces its own price.

soigne.oewn-00854162-s.label: positive
soigne.oewn-00854162-s.tone: Grooming and polish rather than taste; it is about the finish.

soignee.oewn-00854162-s.label: positive
soignee.oewn-00854162-s.tone: The feminine French form, and the commoner spelling in English.

untidy.oewn-02433027-a.label: negative
untidy.oewn-02433027-a.tone: The plain word, and a small complaint - it expects the state to be temporary.

cluttered.oewn-02433722-s.label: negative
cluttered.oewn-02433722-s.tone: About too many things rather than dirt; a cluttered desk can still be working.

littered.oewn-02433722-s.label: negative
littered.oewn-02433722-s.tone: The rubbish sense has taken over, and litter is somebody's fault.

disheveled.oewn-02433993-s.label: negative
disheveled.oewn-02433993-s.tone: Disorder that suggests something happened - the state was not chosen.

dishevelled.oewn-02433993-s.label: negative
dishevelled.oewn-02433993-s.tone: The British spelling, identical in force.

frowzled.oewn-02433993-s.label: negative
frowzled.oewn-02433993-s.tone: Archaic and comic-sounding; using it is a decision.

rumpled.oewn-02433993-s.label: negative
rumpled.oewn-02433993-s.tone: The gentlest word here - rumpled clothes are forgiven, and sometimes liked.

tousled.oewn-02433993-s.label: neutral
tousled.oewn-02433993-s.tone: Disorder that flatters - the one word here that can be arranged on purpose.

disorderly.oewn-02434302-s.label: negative
disorderly.oewn-02434302-s.tone: Also a charge - *disorderly conduct* - which lends the ordinary sense weight.

higgledy-piggledy.oewn-02434302-s.label: negative
higgledy-piggledy.oewn-02434302-s.tone: The sound is the meaning, and it is far too cheerful to condemn much.

hugger-mugger.oewn-02434302-s.label: negative
hugger-mugger.oewn-02434302-s.tone: Older, rarer, and pulled between disorder and secrecy.

jumbled.oewn-02434302-s.label: negative
jumbled.oewn-02434302-s.tone: Order was lost rather than never present - the pieces are all still there.

sincere.oewn-02186899-a.label: positive
sincere.oewn-02186899-a.tone: The plain claim that there is no gap between what is felt and what is said.

bona_fide.oewn-02187327-s.label: positive
bona_fide.oewn-02187327-s.tone: Legal Latin, and it is about standing rather than feeling.

cordial.oewn-02187428-s.label: positive
cordial.oewn-02187428-s.tone: Warmth by convention. *Cordial relations* means nobody has walked out yet.

dear.oewn-02187588-s.label: positive
dear.oewn-02187588-s.tone: A letter-opening formula for the most part, and emptied by that use.

devout.oewn-02187588-s.label: positive
devout.oewn-02187588-s.tone: Religious first, and it carries the discipline of practice with it.

earnest.oewn-02187588-s.label: positive
earnest.oewn-02187588-s.tone: Sincerity that shows its effort, which is why it can be faintly comic.

heartfelt.oewn-02187588-s.label: positive
heartfelt.oewn-02187588-s.tone: Reserved for thanks and condolence, where it still means what it says.

honest.oewn-02187787-s.label: positive
honest.oewn-02187787-s.tone: The broadest word in the family and the one with the most to lose.

genuine.oewn-02187907-s.label: positive
genuine.oewn-02187907-s.tone: Tests the thing against a counterfeit - it presumes fakes are in circulation.

true.oewn-02187907-s.label: positive
true.oewn-02187907-s.tone: The oldest sense of *true*: loyal and unfeigned, not merely correct.

unfeigned.oewn-02187907-s.label: positive
unfeigned.oewn-02187907-s.tone: Defined against pretence, which is a curious way to have to say it.

heart-whole.oewn-02188116-s.label: positive
heart-whole.oewn-02188116-s.tone: Nothing held back and nothing divided; rare and slightly archaic.

wholehearted.oewn-02188116-s.label: positive
wholehearted.oewn-02188116-s.tone: The common form, and the one that still gets used in earnest.

whole-souled.oewn-02188116-s.label: positive
whole-souled.oewn-02188116-s.tone: The most emphatic and the least used of the three.

patient.oewn-01739985-a.label: positive
patient.oewn-01739985-a.tone: Endurance with an even temper - the temper is what distinguishes it from mere waiting.

diligent.oewn-01740371-s.label: positive
diligent.oewn-01740371-s.tone: Patience aimed at work, and it praises the steadiness rather than the result.

persevering.oewn-01740371-s.label: positive
persevering.oewn-01740371-s.tone: The same steadiness against resistance; it presumes there was reason to stop.

enduring.oewn-01740633-s.label: positive
enduring.oewn-01740633-s.tone: Ambiguous, since the commoner sense is *lasting* rather than *bearing*.

long-suffering.oewn-01740633-s.label: positive
long-suffering.oewn-01740633-s.tone: Faintly complaining on the person's behalf - the trouble should have ended by now.

forbearing.oewn-01740820-s.label: positive
forbearing.oewn-01740820-s.tone: Restraint under provocation, when retaliation was available and was declined.

longanimous.oewn-01740820-s.label: positive
longanimous.oewn-01740820-s.tone: The Latinate form of *long-suffering*, and almost extinct.

tolerant.oewn-01741132-s.label: positive
tolerant.oewn-01741132-s.tone: Has moved into politics, where it is about difference rather than difficulty.

patient_of.oewn-01741132-s.label: positive
patient_of.oewn-01741132-s.tone: A construction rather than a word - *patient of delay* - and formal to the point of stiffness.

unhurried.oewn-01741333-s.label: positive
unhurried.oewn-01741333-s.tone: Describes the pace and lets the character be inferred.
